region_chill_delivered_provenance.mid_at: NC State Extension documents that North Carolina gardens receive in excess of 1,000 chilling hours annually, so insufficient chilling rarely occurs; the cooler Piedmont and northern belt (zone 7) banks proportionally more than the warmer Coastal Plain (zone 8). Both zones clear the chilling requirement of every recommended tree-fruit variety. Source: NC State Extension Gardener Handbook, ch. 15 (content.ces.ncsu.edu/extension-gardener-handbook/15-tree-fruit-and-nuts); verified 2026-07-20.
